prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1040; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Neurological examination showed mild cognitive slowing and intermittent balance deficits, with no focal neurological deficits. Cervical strain was noted and assessed concurrently. Imaging was reviewed and did not demonstrate acute intracranial abnormality. The diagnosis was concussion with associated cervical strain.

Treatment consisted of a graduated return-to-activity protocol, vestibular and oculomotor rehabilitation exercises, cervical physical therapy, and cognitive rest recommendations. Over the course of 20 outpatient visits, the patient's symptoms improved steadily, with headache frequency and dizziness decreasing and concentration tolerance returning to near baseline. Balance testing improved, and the patient progressed to full work and driving activities. At the most recent visit, residual mild neck stiffness persisted but the patient was functioning independently and was discharged from active care with a home exercise program and instructions to return if symptoms recur.
